question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Raining cats and dogs

options.text: Cats and dogs getting wet in rain

solution:
The correct answer is **"A very heavy downpour."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"raining cats and dogs"** means a very heavy downpour. (बहुत भारी बारिश)

 
 
• **Example**: *Don't forget to take your umbrella - **it's raining cats and dogs**__ out there.*
 
 
 
• It is not related to cats and dogs getting wet in rain.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
